title: Bases not safe
description: This mod makes aggressive entities intolerant to player bases
body:
Causes aggressive creatures in the radius to move towards interactive blocks. Adds a raid system (the longer the player sits on the base and the more interactive blocks on the base, the faster the raid level increases), which can be customized in config file. Also better watch how loud you speak because you might be heard by aggressive entitties.
> If you have any questions about my mods, message me on Telegram via the link.
